---
title: A Tufte theme for smalldocs
subtitle: Type, measure and rules after Tufte CSS
---

This site shows the theme. The text is set in ET Book, a face cut for Edward
Tufte's books, on a paper that is not quite white. The column is narrow, so a
line holds about seventy letters and the eye finds the start of the next one.
A [link](https://edwardtufte.github.io/tufte-css/) is the colour of the text,
with a thin rule under it.

The theme takes little away from the page and adds less. The navbar has the
colour of the paper. The sidebar and the table of contents are small and grey,
and the current page is in italic. Switch to the dark mode with the button in
the navbar: the paper turns to near black, as in Tufte CSS.

## Use it

Add the theme to a smalldocs project, and name it in `_smalldocs.yml`:

```sh
smalldocs add rahuldave/smalldocs-tufte
```

```yaml
theme: tufte
```

The [guide](guide/install.qmd) has the details, and the
[notes](notes/index.qmd) show a listing of posts.
